name: resolveCNS
title: Resolve CNS Name
description: Resolve a Convex Name System (CNS) name to its target value, typically an actor or library address. Example names: 'convex.asset', 'convex.fungible', 'torus.exchange'.

value.description: Resolved value, typically an address; nil if the name is not registered

errorCode.description: CVM error code if resolution failed
